item.title: Rallying Cry – June 2, 2026
item.description: Today’s good news includes Macron honoring Rwanda genocide victims with a new Paris monument, Microsoft’s fresh AI tools to cut costs and boost security, Ulta’s strong earnings boost, and Android’s new feature to fight phone scams—plus, who knew sturgeon fish sound like thunder?
